content.text:
The three most urgent issues are: **(1)** two laptops that are almost out of disk space and could fill up in about 5–6 days, **(2)** uTorrent, a file-sharing app, installed on one device, and **(3)** constant memory strain on one ThinkPad, which is also one of the two low-disk laptops. I ranked them by detector severity, then by how many devices are affected.

**Evidence**

1. **Disks nearly full and still filling (critical, 2 devices)**
   - E4V0SB5I0MYU (Dell XPS 15, emp-globex-1004): 2.4% free (12.2 GB of 512 GB). Policy calls a disk low below 10% free [disk_low/E4V0SB5I0MYU, E4V0SB5I0MYU/2026-06-12].
   - Its free space fell from 81.6 GB to 12.2 GB over the 30-day window, about 2.4 GB/day. At that rate it is full in about 5 days [disk_trend/E4V0SB5I0MYU, E4V0SB5I0MYU/2026-05-14, E4V0SB5I0MYU/2026-06-12].
   - JRZSGXVMKE6M (ThinkPad X1 Carbon, emp-globex-1005): 2.0% free (20.5 GB of 1024 GB) [disk_low/JRZSGXVMKE6M, JRZSGXVMKE6M/2026-06-12].
   - Its free space fell from 124.8 GB to 20.5 GB, about 3.6 GB/day. At that rate it is full in about 6 days [disk_trend/JRZSGXVMKE6M, JRZSGXVMKE6M/2026-05-14, JRZSGXVMKE6M/2026-06-12].
2. **Risky software: uTorrent on Q1AFVLH3YV33 (high, emp-globex-1003)**
   - It was absent on 2026-05-19 and first seen on 2026-05-20, so it was installed during the window [risky_software/Q1AFVLH3YV33/uTorrent, Q1AFVLH3YV33/2026-05-19, Q1AFVLH3YV33/2026-05-20].
   - The policy lists it under p2p_file_sharing, a common route for malware and data theft [risky_software/Q1AFVLH3YV33/uTorrent].
3. **Memory strain on JRZSGXVMKE6M (high, 16 GB)**
   - Memory use was at or above 80% in 29 of 30 snapshots, averaging 87.6% with a peak of 94.1% [ram_pressure/JRZSGXVMKE6M, JRZSGXVMKE6M/2026-05-14, JRZSGXVMKE6M/2026-06-12].
   - Policy thresholds for "RAM-constrained": ram_pressure_used_pct 80 and ram_pressure_min_share 0.75 [ram_pressure/JRZSGXVMKE6M].
   - This laptop is also one of the low-disk devices in issue 1, so it is the most troubled device in the fleet.

**Next most urgent (medium severity)**
- **Screen lock now failing on 2 devices, up from 0 at the start of the window:**
  - CUXW0BQSV1B7 has failed since 2026-06-05 [compliance_drift/CUXW0BQSV1B7/screen_lock, CUXW0BQSV1B7/2026-06-12].
  - JRZSGXVMKE6M has failed since 2026-05-30 [compliance_drift/JRZSGXVMKE6M/screen_lock, JRZSGXVMKE6M/2026-06-12].
- **OS updates:** 4 of 8 devices fail the os_up_to_date check, the same count as at the start of the window [4SEFDLPTKXAM/2026-06-12, CUXW0BQSV1B7/2026-06-12, Q1AFVLH3YV33/2026-06-12, QPZSXKINA7GP/2026-06-12].
- **Memory strain on CUXW0BQSV1B7:** memory use averaged 85.0% [ram_pressure/CUXW0BQSV1B7].

**Caveats**
- The "full in about 5–6 days" figures are straight-line projections, not certain.
- E4V0SB5I0MYU is missing some battery and network data in a few snapshots. That is a gap in data collection, not a hardware fault [telemetry_gap/E4V0SB5I0MYU].
- No battery end-of-life findings came up.
- I didn't propose any actions because you asked for a summary. The obvious first step would be disk cleanup on the two nearly full laptops.
